headline: Profitability declines broadly, q/q and year over year
summary_short: Public Service Enterprise Group reported Q2 FY2026 diluted EPS of $0.67 (-54.7% q/q, -42.7% y/y) on revenue of $2,554M (-33.6% q/q, -8.9% y/y) and net income of $334M (-54.9% q/q, -42.9% y/y).
summary_long: Revenue of $2,554M fell 33.6% q/q and 8.9% y/y. Gross margin was 30.6% (vs 36.5% q/q, 40.1% y/y) and operating margin 18.0% (vs 27.9% q/q, 29.1% y/y). EPS of $0.67 fell 54.7% q/q and 42.7% y/y on net income of $334M (-54.9% q/q, -42.9% y/y) and EBITDA of $1,042M (-30.7% q/q, -21.7% y/y). Cash fell to $192M (-52.5% q/q, +3.2% y/y). Short-term debt was $850M (+100.0% q/q, -15.0% y/y) against shareholders' equity of $17,329M (+0.2% q/q, +3.9% y/y).
